{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Filter to only converted customers
converted_df = df[df['converted'] == 1]

# Remove rows where customer_age is -1 (sentinel for missing)
valid_converted_df = converted_df[converted_df['customer_age'] != -1]

# Compute mean age
mean_age = valid_converted_df['customer_age'].mean()

# Print the result
mean_age"}
